name: Aero V-dramon
look: a blue dragon crouched to pounce, white chest and shoulder armour, a great white snout horn, curved horns, a V on its chest, wide red wings and white claws
entry: A holy dragon that guards the skies, with red wings and white armour over its blue scales. It strikes with a V-shaped blast of light from its chest.
how: Wild: rare in mountains, peaks and hills.
